positions.name: ErasureDirectives
positions.frame: when a directive commands that something be forgotten or removed, what authority is being exercised over the record?
positions.why: Both expressions are bare imperatives ('Forget the...', 'Remove all knowledge about...') issued in the same flat, unhedged register, targeting named artifacts (a decision, a migration) that the settled bindings found no referent for in this perspective. The directional reads converge here: relational flags both as authority-ranking erasure commands, value flags both as self-originated record control, style flags both as the same command-phrase formula. The two share one directional read — erasure asserted as unilateral command over what the record holds — even though the objects targeted (a decision vs. a body of technical knowledge) differ in kind; that difference is held inside the frame, not resolved by it.
